name: watercup_json_escape
notes: web_json_escape() now escapes control chars < 0x20 to match LIVE Python json.dumps: 0x08->\b, 0x0c->\f (short), 0x00-0x07/0x0b/0x0e-0x1f -> \u00XX. Previously the default pass-through emitted raw control bytes (invalid JSON). Harness checks 0x01/0x0b/0x1b -> \u00XX and 0x08/0x0c -> short; twin confirms against real json.dumps.
